titleZh: 向量、矩阵与坐标系：数学第一次成为机器人动作
titleEn: Vectors, matrices, and frames: when mathematics becomes a robot action
title:
向量、矩阵与坐标系：数学第一次成为机器人动作

Vectors, matrices, and frames: when mathematics becomes a robot action

blocks.text: 本章不从“矩阵乘法的定义”开始，而从一个装配问题开始：相机测到叶片上的定位点，机器人必须把它变成基座坐标中的目标位姿。你将看到，矩阵不是一张数字表，而是一个带输入空间、输出空间、单位和物理语义的动作；矩阵乘法不是背诵规则，而是动作的复合。最后，我们把这些概念写成可运行的 NumPy 实验，并用带 frame 检查的类阻止最危险的坐标错误。

This chapter starts with an assembly problem rather than the definition of matrix multiplication. A camera observes a datum point on an aero-engine blade, and the robot must turn that observation into a target pose in the base frame. A matrix is therefore an action with an input space, an output space, units, and physical meaning; multiplication composes actions. We finish with a runnable NumPy laboratory and a frame-aware class that prevents the most dangerous coordinate bugs.

blocks.text: 2.0 矩阵从哪里来：把许多一次运算写成一个动作 2.0 Where matrices come from: collecting many operations into one action
先不要把矩阵看成“几行数字”。假设一个装配台要把输入 $(x,y)$ 变成两个输出：新的横坐标和新的纵坐标。若规则是 $u=2x-y$、$v=x+3y$，我们可以把系数按“哪个输出依赖哪个输入”排成表。

Do not begin by treating a matrix as a table of numbers. Suppose an assembly table maps $(x,y)$ to two outputs. If the rules are $u=2x-y$ and $v=x+3y$, collect the coefficients according to which output depends on which input.

cells: 一个输出由哪些输入组合而成
一个输入基方向会把输出推向哪里
输入有几项、输出有几项

blocks.text: 矩阵不是凭空发明的记号：它把一组线性方程压缩成一个可复用的“输入到输出”接口。$2\times2$ 的含义来自“两个输入、两个输出”。若输入改成三项而输出仍是两项，矩阵自然变成 $2\times3$。

A matrix is not an arbitrary notation: it compresses a collection of linear equations into a reusable input-output interface. A $2\times2$ matrix means two inputs and two outputs. If the input has three entries while the output still has two, the matrix naturally becomes $2\times3$.

blocks.title: 先问三个问题，再做矩阵乘法 / Ask three questions before multiplying

blocks.text: 输入对象是什么？每个分量的单位和坐标系是什么？输出对象是什么？只有输入空间、输出空间和单位都匹配，乘法才不仅是“能算”，而且有物理意义。
What is the input object? What are the units and frame of each component? What is the output object? Multiplication has physical meaning only when input space, output space, and units match.
2.1 先看任务：相机点如何变成机器人动作 2.1 Start from the task: turning a camera point into a robot action
假设相机观察到叶片上的一个圆孔。图像算法输出像素坐标 $(u,v)$，深度模块把它恢复为相机坐标中的点 $p^C$，而控制器需要的是基座坐标中的点 $p^B$。如果相机固定在工作台上，最小的计算链可以写成

Suppose a camera observes a datum hole on an aero-engine blade. The vision module returns image coordinates $(u,v)$, a depth module reconstructs a point $p^C$ in the camera frame, and the controller needs the same point $p^B$ in the robot-base frame. For a camera fixed on the workbench, the minimal computational chain is
式子短，但它隐藏了四个必须回答的问题：$p^C$ 的三维坐标是以米还是毫米表示？$T_{BC}$ 的下标究竟表示“把 $C$ 表达到 $B$”还是别的约定？点和方向向量是否应该使用同一个变换？标定误差多大时，装配间隙会被耗尽？本章会把每个隐藏问题变成一个明确的接口或检查。

The equation is short, but it hides four engineering questions. Are the coordinates in metres or millimetres? Does the subscript $BC$ mean “express $C$ in $B$” under our convention? Should a point and a free direction vector use the same transform? How large can calibration error be before the assembly clearance is exhausted? Each hidden question becomes an explicit interface or check in this chapter.

blocks.text: 2.2 向量不是“竖着写的数”：先写语义、单位和坐标系 2.2 A vector is not merely a column of numbers: semantics, units, and frames first
向量首先是带语义的对象，其次才是一串数字。位置向量描述点在哪里，位移向量描述从一个位置到另一个位置的变化，速度向量描述位置随时间的变化，误差向量描述当前状态与目标状态之间的差异。它们可能都有三个分量，却不能因为形状相同就互相替换。

A vector is first a semantic object and only then a sequence of numbers. A position says where a point is, a displacement says how one position changes to another, a velocity says how position changes over time, and an error says how the current state differs from a target. They may all have three entries, but equal shapes do not make them interchangeable.
上标 $B$ 表示坐标系；下标表示对象或时间角色。一个可靠的工程记录至少要能回答“这个数组是什么、在哪个 frame、用什么 unit、对应哪个时间戳”。在纸面推导中，这些信息常被省略；在真实机器人中，省略就是错误来源。

The superscript $B$ denotes a coordinate frame; subscripts can denote an object or a time role. A reliable engineering record must answer what an array represents, in which frame, in which unit, and at which timestamp. Such metadata are often omitted on paper; in a real robot, that omission is a source of failure.

blocks.text: 一个立即可用的检查 An immediate check
当你看到一行代码 `error = goal - current` 时，不要先问“NumPy 是否能运行”。先问：两个数组是否表达同一类对象？是否在同一坐标系？是否同一单位？是否对应同一时刻？只有四个答案都是“是”，减法才有物理意义。

When you see `error = goal - current`, do not first ask whether NumPy can execute it. Ask whether the arrays represent the same kind of object, share a frame, share a unit, and refer to compatible times. Only four “yes” answers make the subtraction physically meaningful.
2.3 矩阵的阶：输入和输出空间的契约 2.3 Matrix order: a contract between input and output spaces
设输入是 $n$ 维列向量 $x\in\mathbb{R}^{n}$，输出是 $m$ 维列向量 $y\in\mathbb{R}^{m}$。一个矩阵 $A\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ 表示从输入空间到输出空间的线性映射 $y=Ax$。因此，“$m$ 行 $n$ 列”不是排版信息，而是这个动作需要多少个输入分量、产生多少个输出分量。

Let $x\in\mathbb{R}^{n}$ be an $n$-dimensional column vector and $y\in\mathbb{R}^{m}$ an $m$-dimensional output. A matrix $A\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ represents a linear map from the input space to the output space: $y=Ax$. Thus, $m$ rows and $n$ columns are not formatting facts; they state how many input components the action consumes and how many output components it produces.
从行的角度看，矩阵的每一行是一个线性测量器；从列的角度看，第 $j$ 列是输入基向量 $e_j$ 被映射后的结果。于是
From the row view, each row is a linear measurement of the input. From the column view, column $j$ is the image of the input basis vector $e_j$. Therefore
矩阵的列告诉我们：输入空间的各个基方向经过这个动作后变成了什么。对旋转矩阵来说，列向量是旋转后的坐标轴；对相机投影来说，矩阵把三维方向映射为图像中的变化。后面的 Jacobian 也会沿用这个“每一列代表一个输入方向作用”的解释，但本章暂不要求计算它。

The columns tell us what happens to the basis directions of the input space. For a rotation matrix, columns are the rotated coordinate axes; for a camera projection, they describe image changes caused by 3-D directions. The later Jacobian will reuse this interpretation, but this chapter does not require computing one yet.

2.4 矩阵乘法为什么有顺序：它是动作的复合 2.4 Why matrix multiplication has an order: composition of actions
如果动作 $A$ 先把原始输入变成中间对象 $z$，动作 $B$ 再把 $z$ 变成输出 $y$，则
If action $A$ first maps an input to an intermediate object $z$ and action $B$ maps $z$ to the output $y$, then
右侧矩阵先作用，不是课本任意规定，而是函数复合的书写方式。机器人变换链中，如果点先从工具坐标系 $E$ 到腕部坐标系 $W$，再到基座 $B$，就必须写
The rightmost matrix acts first because this is function composition. If a point goes from the tool frame $E$ to the wrist frame $W$ and then to the base frame $B$, the chain is
交换两个矩阵通常不会报错，因为它们的形状仍然相容；但它改变了物理动作。下面的二维例子把“先平移再旋转”和“先旋转再平移”故意分开。

Swapping two matrices often does not trigger a shape error because the dimensions remain compatible, but it changes the physical action. The following planar example deliberately separates “translate then rotate” from “rotate then translate.”
两个结果都像“合理坐标”，但它们对应不同动作。科研代码中，变换链应当用下标和单元测试表达，而不是依赖作者记忆。

Both results look like reasonable coordinates, but they describe different actions. In research code, a transform chain should be expressed by frame labels and tests rather than by the author's memory.
2.5 旋转矩阵：保长度、保角度，而不是任意二维矩阵 2.5 Rotation matrices: preserving length and angle, not arbitrary 2-D matrices
二维旋转矩阵由一个角度决定：
A 2-D rotation matrix is determined by one angle:
它满足 $R^TR=I$ 和 $\det R=1$。前者说明列向量正交且为单位长度，后者排除了镜像反射。于是
It satisfies $R^TR=I$ and $\det R=1$. The first identity says the columns are orthonormal; the second excludes a mirror reflection. Therefore
这个推导解释了为什么旋转不会改变刚体上两点之间的距离。它也给出代码中的断言：如果某个“旋转矩阵”明显破坏长度，优先检查角度单位、数值类型和矩阵下标，而不是继续调控制器。

This derivation explains why rotation does not change the distance between two points on a rigid body. It also gives a code assertion: if a purported rotation changes lengths noticeably, first check angle units, numeric types, and frame indices before tuning a controller.

blocks.code:
import numpy as np

def rotate_90(vector: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    vector = np.asarray(vector, dtype=float)
    if vector.shape != (2,):
        raise ValueError("expected a two-dimensional vector")
    rotation = np.array([[0.0, -1.0],
                         [1.0,  0.0]])
    result = rotation @ vector
    assert np.isclose(np.linalg.norm(result), np.linalg.norm(vector))
    assert np.allclose(rotation.T @ rotation, np.eye(2))
    return result

point_local = np.array([1.0, 2.0])
print(rotate_90(point_local))  # [-2.  1.]

blocks.text: 2.6 坐标系：一个物理点的多种数字表达 2.6 Frames: several numerical expressions of one physical point
一个物理点只有一个位置，但它在不同坐标系中的数字表达可能不同。相机看到 $p^C$，机器人基座使用 $p^B$，世界模型使用 $p^W$。下标或上标必须写清楚，否则减法、插值和控制误差都没有明确语义。

A physical point has one location, but its numerical expression can differ across frames. A camera observes $p^C$, the robot base uses $p^B$, and a world model uses $p^W$. Frame labels must be explicit; otherwise subtraction, interpolation, and control errors have no precise meaning.

blocks.caption: 一个物理点的多 frame 表达，以及 frame 误差如何消耗装配间隙 / One physical point in multiple frames, and how frame error consumes assembly clearance

blocks.text: 注意“坐标系的旋转”和“向量的旋转”不是一句话可以混用的两种约定。工程中可以选择主动旋转（旋转物体）或被动变换（改变表达坐标），但必须在项目开始时固定约定，并在每个 API 文档中写出输入和输出 frame。

Do not casually mix active rotation of an object with passive change of coordinates. A project may choose either convention, but it must fix the convention and state input and output frames in every API.

blocks.title: 从二维到三维的桥 Bridge from 2-D to 3-D

blocks.text: 二维图上的 $R(\theta)$ 只有一个角度；三维刚体位姿属于 $SE(3)$，旋转有三个自由度，常用 $3\times3$ 旋转矩阵与三维平移组合成 $4\times4$ 齐次变换。这里暂时不要求你先学习 Lie 群；你只需记住两个不变的工程问题：每个矩阵描述哪两个 frame，以及它作用在点、向量还是速度上。后续第 27 章再建立 $SO(3)$、$SE(3)$ 和指数映射的完整桥接。
2.7 齐次变换：为什么要多加一个 1 2.7 Homogeneous transforms: why append a 1
旋转写成 $Rp$，平移写成 $p+t$。如果只使用 $2\times2$ 矩阵，就无法用同一种矩阵乘法把平移也组合进去。齐次坐标把平面点扩展为 $\tilde p=[p^T,1]^T$：

Rotation is written as $Rp$ and translation as $p+t$. With only a $2\times2$ matrix, translation cannot be composed by the same multiplication. Homogeneous coordinates augment a planar point to $\tilde p=[p^T,1]^T$:
展开最后一行可知齐次分量仍为 1；展开前两行得到 $p^B=R_{BA}p^A+t_{BA}$。这个“多加一个维度”的技巧并不是增加了物理自由度，而是把仿射动作放进了可以组合的线性表示。

Expanding the last row shows that the homogeneous component remains one; expanding the first two rows gives $p^B=R_{BA}p^A+t_{BA}$. The extra dimension does not add a physical degree of freedom. It embeds an affine action in a composable linear representation.
点和方向向量的差异在齐次坐标中非常清楚：点的最后一维是 1，方向向量的最后一维是 0。因此同一个 $T$ 对点包含平移，对方向不包含平移。

The difference between a point and a direction vector is explicit in homogeneous coordinates: a point has last component 1, while a free vector has last component 0. The same $T$ therefore translates a point but not a direction.
2.8 变换链：把下标当作类型系统 2.8 Transform chains: use subscripts as a type system
采用“$T_{BA}$ 把 $A$ 中的表达变成 $B$ 中的表达”的约定。于是
Use the convention that $T_{BA}$ converts an expression in frame $A$ into an expression in frame $B$. Then

blocks.latex:
T_{BA}:A\to B,\qquad T_{CB}:B\to C,\qquad
  T_{CA}=T_{CB}T_{BA}:A\to C.

blocks.text: 这与函数类型或物理量的单位检查完全类似：只有前一个变换的输出 frame 与后一个变换的输入 frame 相等，链才合法。裸矩阵会允许很多“维度正确但物理错误”的乘法；带 frame 的对象可以在运行时尽早拒绝它。

This is analogous to function types or unit checking: a chain is legal only when the output frame of one transform equals the input frame of the next. Bare matrices allow many dimensionally valid but physically wrong products; frame-aware objects can reject them early.

blocks.title: 最危险的四类错误 Four dangerous failure modes

items: 顺序错误：把 $T_{CB}T_{BA}$ 写成 $T_{BA}T_{CB}$；程序可运行，物理位置错误。
方向错误：把 $T_{BA}$ 当作 $T_{AB}$ 使用；尤其容易出现在相机外参和机器人基座外参之间。
单位错误：标定文件用 mm，仿真模型用 m；结果可能相差 $10^3$，但没有类型错误。
点/向量错误：把法向量当作点进行变换；平移会污染方向，抓取姿态因此偏离。

items: 在纸上画出每个 frame 的原点和轴方向；
在每个变换旁边写出“输入 frame $\to$ 输出 frame”；
对一个简单点（如原点或单位轴点）逐步计算；

blocks.text: 2.9 可运行实验一：写一个不会沉默出错的 FrameTransform 2.9 Runnable lab I: a FrameTransform that fails loudly
下面的类把四个元数据放进同一个对象：输入 frame、输出 frame、长度单位和矩阵。它不是为了“面向对象更高级”，而是为了让一个原本只能靠注释维护的物理约束变成可执行检查。

The class below stores four pieces of metadata together: source frame, target frame, length unit, and matrix. It is not object-oriented ornamentation; it turns a physical constraint that would otherwise live only in comments into an executable check.
先观察接口，再观察数值：`apply_point` 的最后一维是 1，`apply_vector` 的最后一维相当于 0；`then` 只允许 $A\to B$ 接 $B\to C$。这三行设计决定了后面的数值结果是否值得相信。

Inspect the interface before inspecting the numbers. The last homogeneous component is 1 for `apply_point` and effectively 0 for `apply_vector`; `then` allows $A\to B$ only to be followed by $B\to C$. These design choices determine whether later numerical results deserve trust.

blocks.code:
transform = FrameTransform.from_angle_translation(
    source="camera", target="base", unit="m",
    theta_rad=np.deg2rad(90.0), translation=[2.0, 3.0]
)
point_base = transform.apply_point([1.0, 0.0])
vector_base = transform.apply_vector([1.0, 0.0])
assert np.allclose(point_base, [2.0, 4.0])
assert np.allclose(vector_base, [0.0, 1.0])

blocks.text: 如果把方向向量错误地作为点输入，得到的是 $[2,4]^T$ 而不是 $[0,1]^T$。这个错误会让末端姿态、接触法向和力控方向同时偏移，而且通常不会触发异常。

If a free direction is incorrectly passed as a point, the result is $[2,4]^T$ instead of $[0,1]^T$. This can simultaneously corrupt end-effector orientation, contact normals, and force-control directions without raising an exception.
2.10 可运行实验二：用刚体对应点做二维标定 2.10 Runnable lab II: planar calibration from corresponding rigid points
现在把矩阵从“已知动作”推进到“由数据估计的动作”。相机和机器人之间的外参可以通过若干对应点估计。给定相机点 $p_i^C$ 与基座点 $p_i^B$，希望找到

We now move from a known matrix action to an action estimated from data. Camera-to-base extrinsics can be estimated from corresponding points. Given camera points $p_i^C$ and base points $p_i^B$, we seek
平移和旋转耦合在原式中。先减去两组点的质心即可把平移消掉：
Translation and rotation are coupled in the original expression. Subtracting the two centroids removes translation:
令 $H=(Q^C)^TQ^B$，对 $H$ 做 SVD：$H=U\Sigma V^T$。二维 Kabsch 解为 $R=V D U^T$，其中 $D$ 在检测到反射时把最后一个奇异方向乘以 $-1$。这一步把“矩阵估计”变成“保持刚体性质的矩阵估计”，而不是直接对九个未知数做无约束拟合。

Let $H=(Q^C)^TQ^B$ and compute its SVD $H=U\Sigma V^T$. The 2-D Kabsch solution is $R=VDU^T$, with the last singular direction negated if the unconstrained solution is a reflection. This estimates a matrix while preserving the rigid-body constraint instead of fitting unconstrained entries.

blocks.code:
source_center = source.mean(axis=0)
target_center = target.mean(axis=0)
centered_source = source - source_center
centered_target = target - target_center
covariance = centered_source.T @ centered_target
u, singular_values, vt = np.linalg.svd(covariance)
correction = np.eye(2)
if np.linalg.det(vt.T @ u.T) < 0.0:
    correction[-1, -1] = -1.0
r = vt.T @ correction @ u.T
t = target_center - r @ source_center

blocks.text: 代码中的 `singular_values[-1]` 还承担退化检测功能。如果所有标定点几乎落在同一个点，或几何分布不足以确定旋转，SVD 会告诉我们“问题没有被数据识别”，而不是给出一个看似精确的姿态。

The smallest singular value also supports degeneracy detection. If all calibration points nearly coincide, or their geometry is insufficient to determine rotation, the SVD tells us that the problem is unidentifiable instead of returning a seemingly precise pose.
2.11 误差、噪声与条件数：为什么几何布局很重要 2.11 Error, noise, and conditioning: why point layout matters
两组对应点即使没有明显离群值，也可能无法稳定估计旋转。若点分布过于集中，微小的像素或深度噪声会导致较大的角度变化；若点几乎共线，某些方向的信息不足。数值线性代数把这种现象称为病态或条件数过大。

Even without obvious outliers, a point set may be unable to estimate rotation stably. If points are tightly clustered, small pixel or depth noise can cause a large angular change; if they are nearly collinear, information in some directions is missing. Numerical linear algebra describes this as ill-conditioning or a large condition number.
这里的 $\kappa$ 不是“算法好坏”的抽象分数，而是数据几何对误差放大的警告。标定实验应报告点集的尺度、覆盖面积、最小奇异值、拟合 RMSE，并在不同噪声和随机种子下重复，而不是只报告一次漂亮的矩阵。

Here $\kappa$ is not an abstract score of algorithm quality; it warns how the data geometry amplifies error. A calibration experiment should report point-set scale, spatial coverage, the smallest singular value, fit RMSE, and repetitions across noise levels and seeds rather than one attractive matrix.

blocks.title: 装配容差的回推 Back-propagating an assembly tolerance

blocks.text: 若叶片装配允许的平面位置误差只有 $0.20\,\mathrm{mm}$，而标定的平移 RMSE 已为 $0.35\,\mathrm{mm}$，继续训练策略网络并不能修复这个几何瓶颈。应先检查相机内参、外参、点的空间覆盖和单位约定。只有几何误差低于任务容差，后续的规划和强化学习才有机会学习到真正的装配策略。
2.12 代码中的形状、单位与断言 2.12 Shapes, units, and assertions in code
NumPy 的数组只知道形状和 dtype，不知道“米”“基座 frame”或“这是一个方向向量”。因此本书的最低代码规范不是“能运行”，而是“让错误尽早暴露”。

A NumPy array knows its shape and dtype, but not metres, base frame, or whether it is a direction. The minimum coding standard in this book is therefore not “it runs” but “errors become visible early.”

rows: 点是 $(2,)$ 或 $(3,)$；批量点是 $(N,2)$ 或 $(N,3)$；禁止悄悄接受转置
是否保留 batch 维；是否返回齐次坐标

是否允许 NaN、Inf、深度小于零
形状、正交性、行列式、逆变换、残差和容差

blocks.text: 例如，`np.matmul` 可以把一个 $(3,3)$ 矩阵乘以一个 $(3,)$ 数组，但它无法判断这个数组是点还是向量，也无法判断矩阵方向。好的接口在调用前后都保留语义信息；好的实验让断言失败时给出能定位问题的消息。

For example, `np.matmul` can multiply a $(3,3)$ matrix by a $(3,)$ array, but it cannot tell whether that array is a point or a vector, nor which way the matrix maps frames. A good interface preserves semantics before and after the call; a good experiment gives a diagnostic message when an assertion fails.
2.13 完整实验：从真值、噪声到可复现报告 2.13 Full experiment: from ground truth and noise to a reproducible report
运行 `linear_algebra_frames_lab.py` 会生成四个指标：拟合 RMSE、真值在噪声数据上的 RMSE、平移误差和旋转误差。实验固定随机种子只是为了复现，并不意味着一个种子足够证明方法有效。

Running `linear_algebra_frames_lab.py` produces four metrics: fit RMSE, the ground-truth RMSE on noisy data, translation error, and rotation error. A fixed seed makes the run reproducible; it does not make one seed sufficient evidence for a method.

blocks.code:
def run_calibration_demo(seed: int = 7, noise_std: float = 0.002):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    source = np.array([[0.0, 0.0], [0.30, 0.02],
                       [0.06, 0.25], [0.22, 0.31]])
    truth = FrameTransform.from_angle_translation(
        "camera", "base", "m", np.deg2rad(27.0), [0.42, -0.18])
    target_clean = np.vstack([truth.apply_point(p) for p in source])
    target_noisy = target_clean + rng.normal(
        0.0, noise_std, size=target_clean.shape)
    estimate = fit_rigid_2d(source, target_noisy, unit="m")
    return calibration_rmse(estimate, source, target_noisy)

blocks.text: 日期：2.0cm0.4pt；代码版本：2.6cm0.4pt；Python/NumPy 版本：2.6cm0.4pt；seed：1.2cm0.4pt。\ 点数量：1.2cm0.4pt；点集包围盒：2.2cm0.4pt；噪声标准差：1.8cm0.4pt；拟合 RMSE：1.8cm0.4pt。\ 是否通过逆变换测试：1.5cm0.4pt；是否报告退化检查：1.5cm0.4pt；下一次只改变的变量：3.0cm0.4pt。
研究中“只改变一个变量”比随意多跑几次更重要。例如先固定点集和真值变换，只扫描噪声标准差；再固定噪声，比较集中点集与覆盖工作空间的点集。这样才能回答“误差来自算法，还是来自观测几何”。

In research, changing one variable at a time is more valuable than running arbitrary extra trials. First fix the point set and ground truth and sweep noise; then fix noise and compare clustered points with points covering the workspace. This separates algorithmic error from observation geometry.
2.13A 完整主源与契约测试：矩阵必须携带 frame 语义 2.13A Complete source and contract tests: matrices must carry frame semantics
前面的手算和片段回答了“矩阵怎样作用”，下面的完整模块回答“程序怎样阻止物理上无意义但维度合法的矩阵运算”。`FrameTransform` 同时保存 source、target、unit 和齐次矩阵；点使用齐次分量 1，方向使用旋转块；复合要求中间 frame 和单位一致；逆变换同时交换语义方向。裸矩阵乘法没有这些信息，因此只能作为对象内部实现，不能直接成为系统接口。

The hand calculations and snippets above explain how a matrix acts. The complete module below explains how software rejects physically meaningless but dimensionally legal multiplication. `FrameTransform` stores source, target, unit, and a homogeneous matrix. Points use homogeneous coordinate 1, vectors use only the rotation block, composition requires matching intermediate frames and units, and inversion swaps semantic direction. A bare matrix lacks this information and should remain an internal implementation rather than a system interface.

blocks.text: 测试先区分点与方向的平移语义，再检查 frame 复合和单位不匹配；随后用无噪声对应点恢复真值变换，用逆变换做往返，主动注入 NaN 角度、非正交旋转、共线标定点和空 RMSE 数据，最后验证固定 seed 的报告完全一致。若基础几何测试失败，后续 PnP、手眼标定、视觉伺服和多机状态融合都不应继续。

Tests first distinguish translation semantics for points and vectors, then check frame composition and unit mismatch. They recover a ground-truth transform from noiseless correspondences, perform an inverse round trip, inject a NaN angle, a non-orthogonal rotation, collinear calibration points, and empty RMSE data, and finally verify exact report reproducibility under a fixed seed. If foundational geometry fails, PnP, hand--eye calibration, visual servoing, and multi-robot state fusion must not continue.

blocks.caption: 线性代数与 frame 完整契约测试 / Complete linear-algebra and frame contract tests
blocks.code:
import unittest

import numpy as np

from linear_algebra_frames_lab import (
    FrameError,
    FrameTransform,
    calibration_rmse,
    fit_rigid_2d,
    rotation,
    run_calibration_demo,
)


class LinearAlgebraFramesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_point_and_vector_have_different_translation_semantics(self) -> None:
        transform = FrameTransform.from_angle_translation("A", "B", "m", np.pi / 2, [2.0, 3.0])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(transform.apply_point([1.0, 0.0]), [2.0, 4.0])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(transform.apply_vector([1.0, 0.0]), [0.0, 1.0], atol=1e-12)


    def test_composition_checks_intermediate_frame(self) -> None:
        first = FrameTransform.from_angle_translation("A", "B", "m", 0.0, [1.0, 0.0])
        second = FrameTransform.from_angle_translation("B", "C", "m", 0.0, [0.0, 2.0])
        composed = first.then(second)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(composed.apply_point([0.0, 0.0]), [1.0, 2.0])
        with self.assertRaises(FrameError):
            first.then(FrameTransform.from_angle_translation("C", "D", "m", 0.0, [0.0, 0.0]))


    def test_svd_rigid_fit_recovers_transform_with_small_noise(self) -> None:
        source = np.array([[0.0, 0.0], [0.3, 0.0], [0.0, 0.2], [0.2, 0.3]])
        truth = FrameTransform.from_angle_translation("source", "target", "m", 0.35, [0.4, -0.1])
        target = np.vstack([truth.apply_point(point) for point in source])
        estimate = fit_rigid_2d(source, target)
        np.testing.assert_allclose(estimate.matrix, truth.matrix, atol=1e-10)

    def test_inverse_round_trip_and_unit_mismatch(self) -> None:
        transform = FrameTransform.from_angle_translation("camera", "base", "m", .4, [.2, -.1])
        point = np.array([.3, .5])
        np.testing.assert_allclose(transform.inverse().apply_point(transform.apply_point(point)), point)
        with self.assertRaises(FrameError):
            transform.then(FrameTransform.from_angle_translation("base", "tool", "mm", 0., [0., 0.]))

    def test_invalid_rigid_geometry_fails_at_admission(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaises(FrameError):
            rotation(np.nan)
        with self.assertRaises(FrameError):
            FrameTransform("A", "B", "m", [[2., 0., 0.], [0., 1., 0.], [0., 0., 1.]])
        with self.assertRaises(FrameError):
            fit_rigid_2d([[0., 0.], [1., 0.], [2., 0.]], [[0., 0.], [1., 0.], [2., 0.]])
        with self.assertRaises(FrameError):
            calibration_rmse(FrameTransform.from_angle_translation("A", "B", "m", 0., [0., 0.]), [], [])

    def test_calibration_demo_is_deterministic(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(run_calibration_demo(seed=11), run_calibration_demo(seed=11))
        with self.assertRaises(FrameError):
            run_calibration_demo(noise_std=-1.)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

blocks.title: 从二维教学基线迁移到三维 $SE(3)$ From the planar teaching baseline to 3-D $SE(3)$

blocks.text: 迁移到 $4\times4$ 变换时，接口仍保存 source、target 和 unit；旋转检查从 $SO(2)$ 变为 $SO(3)$；点/方向齐次分量仍分别为 1/0；复合和逆的 frame 规则不变；标定退化由二维共线扩展为三维点/运动激励不足。先保持这些测试语义，再替换为李群、四元数或机器人库。

When moving to $4\times4$ transforms, retain source, target, and unit; replace the $SO(2)$ check with $SO(3)$; keep homogeneous coordinates 1/0 for points/vectors; preserve frame rules for composition and inversion; and generalize planar collinearity to insufficient 3-D point or motion excitation. Keep these test semantics before replacing implementation with Lie groups, quaternions, or a robotics library.
2.14 失败案例：看起来合理的结果为什么仍然错 2.14 Failure cases: why a plausible result can still be wrong
失败一：角度单位混用 Failure 1: mixing degrees and radians
Python 的三角函数使用弧度。如果把 $90$ 当成弧度传入，$\cos(90)$ 不是 0，而是约 $-0.448$。矩阵依然是 $2\times2$，程序也能运行；只有物理不变量或可视化才能揭露它。

Python trigonometric functions use radians. If $90$ is passed as radians, $\cos(90)$ is about $-0.448$, not 0. The matrix remains $2\times2$ and the program runs; only invariants or visualization reveal the error.
失败二：用逆变换替代正变换 Failure 2: using the inverse instead of the forward transform
外参文件常见两种命名：camera-to-base 与 base-to-camera。若只看文件名中的“外参”，而没有验证一个已知点，容易把 $T_{BC}$ 和 $T_{CB}=T_{BC}^{-1}$ 互换。最小测试是：用一个基座中已知点转换到相机，再转换回来，检查误差是否小于容差。

Extrinsic files often use names such as camera-to-base and base-to-camera. If one reads only “extrinsics” and does not test a known point, $T_{BC}$ and $T_{CB}=T_{BC}^{-1}$ are easily swapped. A minimal test maps a known point to the camera and back and checks the error against a tolerance.
失败三：用点变换法向量 Failure 3: transforming a normal as a point
装配接触的法向量应该只受旋转影响。若法向量从 $[0,1]^T$ 开始，错误的点变换会把平移也加进去，得到一个长度和方向都不对的量。代码层面必须提供不同名字的 `apply_point` 与 `apply_vector`，而不是一个“万能 transform”。

A contact normal should be affected only by rotation. If a normal starts at $[0,1]^T$, an incorrect point transform adds translation and produces a vector with wrong length and direction. The code should expose separate `apply_point` and `apply_vector` methods instead of one “universal transform.”
失败四：把毫米直接送入米制仿真 Failure 4: sending millimetres into a metre-based simulator
如果视觉输出是 $[120,80]$ mm，却作为 $[120,80]$ m 传给仿真，机械臂目标会离工作空间数百倍远。更隐蔽的情况是只在某个模块中完成了单位换算，导致一半的链路用 mm、另一半用 m。单位应在系统边界统一，并在数据结构和日志中记录。

If vision outputs $[120,80]$ mm but the simulator receives $[120,80]$ m, the target lies hundreds of times outside the workspace. A subtler case converts units in only one module, leaving half the chain in mm and half in m. Normalize units at system boundaries and record them in data structures and logs.
2.15 从矩阵走向后续机器人知识 2.15 From matrices to the rest of robotics
本章的矩阵不是一个孤立的数学岛。它会在后续内容中反复出现：
The matrices in this chapter are not an isolated mathematics island. They reappear throughout the rest of the book:

items: Jacobian：每一列是一个关节速度对末端速度的局部贡献，矩阵的形状直接由自由度和任务空间决定； Jacobian: each column is a joint-velocity contribution to end-effector velocity; its shape follows the degrees of freedom and task space.
视觉：内参和外参把像素、相机点、基座点连接起来；投影矩阵的维度表达了观测从三维到二维的压缩； Vision: intrinsics and extrinsics connect pixels, camera points, and base points; projection dimensions express the 3-D to 2-D compression.
控制：误差向量必须在同一个 frame 中定义，比例控制 $u=K e$ 的增益矩阵必须匹配输入输出单位； Control: define the error in one frame, and match the gain matrix to input and output units.
规划：轨迹离散后成为状态矩阵，约束可以写成线性不等式或局部线性化； Planning: a discretized trajectory becomes a state matrix, and constraints become linear inequalities or local linearizations.
标定与估计：最小二乘、QR、SVD 和条件数决定几何参数是否可识别； Calibration and estimation: least squares, QR, SVD, and conditioning determine whether geometry is identifiable.
多机协同：每台机器人有本地 frame，通信时必须把状态和约束变换到共同的世界或任务 frame。 Multi-robot coordination: transform local states and constraints into a shared world or task frame before communication.

blocks.title: 口述模板：为什么矩阵乘法有顺序？ Oral template: why does matrix multiplication have an order?

blocks.text: 我不会把矩阵乘法解释成一个需要背诵的规则。若 $A$ 把输入映射到中间空间，$B$ 再把中间空间映射到输出，那么复合动作是 $B(Ax)=(BA)x$。在机器人中，下标还必须匹配 frame；因此 $T_{CB}T_{BA}$ 表示先从 $A$ 到 $B$，再从 $B$ 到 $C$。交换顺序可能仍然满足维度要求，但改变了物理动作。

I do not explain matrix multiplication as a rule to memorize. If $A$ maps an input to an intermediate space and $B$ maps the intermediate space to the output, the composition is $B(Ax)=(BA)x$. In robotics, the frame subscripts must also match, so $T_{CB}T_{BA}$ means $A$ to $B$ followed by $B$ to $C$. Swapping the order may remain dimensionally valid but changes the physical action.
